title: Independent platform requirement evidence proposal
method: Read exact acceptance criteria, inspect relevant source and named tests, inspect actual retained PostgreSQL/startup/restore/browser/test artifacts, and separate incomplete software from external authorization. The only audit-time application change was the expressly authorized public transcript-retention disclosure correction, which passed its focused regression.

status_policy.implemented_unverified: Code exists; stated acceptance has not been demonstrated.
status_policy.verified_local: Stated behavior passed a named local test or inspection; no live supplier inference.
status_policy.verified_external: Real deployed/provider/customer evidence supports the stated acceptance.
status_policy.blocked_external: Work depends on a specifically missing external account, rights, infrastructure, person or observation.
status_policy.deferred_by_product_gate: Original blueprint explicitly places feature behind an unmet product/evidence gate; retain exact rationale.
status_policy.not_applicable_with_reason: Explicit controlling decision removes applicability; never a silent omission.

interpretation: verified_local covers only the explicitly stated tested/inspected behavior and acceptance boundary. implemented_unverified means that full acceptance remains incomplete even where sub-behavior passed tests. blocked_external identifies a specific missing outside authorization or observation; it does not hide local implementation gaps.

observed_test_suite.note: Observed retained artifact at assessment time; not a new test execution by this audit. Parent may replace it after the final waitlist-payment regression; this snapshot does not predict later test counts.

excludes: Voice/media-owned entries in voice-requirement-evidence.json except supporting evidence
Frontend-only workflows; overlapping platform API checks are intentional
coverage.overlap_policy: Merge evidence and retain the strictest still-unmet full acceptance; a passing UI or prototype test does not erase an incomplete backend/provider requirement.

requirements.title: Reproducible startup
requirements.acceptance: A clean checkout starts API, worker and UI with documented commands and seeded fictional tenants.
requirements.verified_behavior: Documented host entry points and a clean built-wheel extraction/import with fresh SQLite were exercised: application health, root UI, caller route, fictional demo login, operations job tick and exclusion of test modules from the wheel all passed (7/7). Backend/frontend lock files and documented commands support reproducing the development startup.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Actual clean built-wheel and fresh development database startup using the current built frontend and installed locked dependencies. Not a fresh operating system, executed Docker build, production deployment, or standalone worker process-signal drill; those separate gates remain explicit.

requirements.title: Durable relational state
requirements.acceptance: Appointments, holds, sessions, consent, tasks, messages, usage and payment state survive process restart.
requirements.verified_behavior: Business state is mapped to durable relational tables rather than process globals. Independent PostgreSQL connections observe committed booking/outbox state; the encrypted restore drill preserved all 51 table counts and restored decryptable appointment identity.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Proves durable database records and restoration in the isolated synthetic database; not a production failover or every-process crash drill.

requirements.title: PostgreSQL deployment
requirements.acceptance: Deployment uses PostgreSQL with validated schema/migrations and independent-connection contention tests.
requirements.verified_behavior: Production rejects SQLite and requires migration baseline 0001 plus mapped schema/constraint validation. Actual PostgreSQL 16.2 tests used independent connections for 402 operations, including 100 contenders each for slots, holds, a shared resource, and idempotency replay.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Isolated local PostgreSQL validation; not customer-database load or production throughput certification.

requirements.title: SQLite development profile
requirements.acceptance: Development profile is explicitly limited and cannot be confused with multi-instance production validation.
requirements.verified_behavior: SQLite is explicitly a local development profile with foreign keys, WAL and bounded busy timeout. Production validation refuses it, and documentation separates SQLite tests from PostgreSQL contention evidence.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Dependency reproducibility
requirements.acceptance: Backend and frontend dependencies are pinned/locked; installation and build are repeatable.
requirements.verified_behavior: Backend dependency versions and the tested transitive graph are pinned; frontend npm lockfile and build script exist. Dependency remediation records the installed cryptography/pip updates and audit result, and the final test artifact records the actual installed test run.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Dependency and build reproducibility controls are verified locally; no claim of hermetic model-weight or container reproducibility on every operating system.

requirements.title: Configuration validation
requirements.acceptance: Invalid origins, missing secrets, provider setup and illegal limits fail with actionable startup errors.
requirements.verified_behavior: Production startup rejects demo mode, unsafe default/weak signing and encryption keys, missing independent lookup key, SQLite and insecure/wildcard origins. Schema mismatch also blocks startup; all ten isolated startup checks passed.
remaining_acceptance: Validate every enabled optional provider configuration and runtime numeric limit at startup. Current validation does not comprehensively reject invalid token lifetimes, media concurrency environment limits, or incomplete enabled provider/version/region settings before serving requests.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Demo and production separation
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic practices, SMS/payment simulation and debug verification codes are labelled; production rejects test shortcuts.
requirements.verified_behavior: Demo seeds and fixed synthetic OTP/payment/delivery shortcuts are explicitly identified. Production refuses DEMO_MODE and default secrets; demo delivery never calls a real provider, and real payment verification uses server-verified amount and published clinic terms.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Health and readiness
requirements.acceptance: API reports its own readiness and degraded dependency state accurately without disclosing secrets.
requirements.verified_behavior: The public health route accurately reports application/database reachability and mode, returning 503 for database failure. Scoped operations health exposes queue ages, worker heartbeat freshness, minute-budget exposure and recorded incidents; provider configuration is labelled unverified.
remaining_acceptance: Add bounded readiness/degradation observations for the enabled speech, messaging, payment and media dependencies. Configuration presence is not live dependency health, and /health currently checks only the database.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Graceful shutdown
requirements.acceptance: API/worker/media processes end in-flight work safely, close handles and preserve recoverable jobs.
requirements.verified_behavior: API lifespan cancels and awaits its optional worker. Media workers use bounded leases and cleanup, and abandoned non-idempotent sends become UNKNOWN rather than being replayed. Durable outbox state supports later reconciliation.
remaining_acceptance: Execute SIGTERM/forced-stop tests during in-flight API, standalone job and media operations, asserting handle closure and subsequent recovery. Standalone worker termination is not covered by a complete retained process-signal drill.

The latest real RTC SDK smoke passed 8/8 functional checks but emitted one native caller cleanup warning: Attempted to drop unknown FFI handle. Review the SDK/room lifecycle before deployment; the warning alone proves neither a resource leak nor its absence.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Schema migration and rollback
requirements.acceptance: Versioned migrations have tested upgrade and documented rollback/recovery procedures.
requirements.verified_behavior: The initial release uses versioned baseline 0001, PostgreSQL advisory migration serialization, idempotent repeat execution, rejection of unversioned populated databases and drift detection. Recovery documentation requires a compatible prior image or a verified isolated pre-change restore, with intervening activity reconciliation.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Verified new-database to initial-baseline migration and restore procedure only. There is no historical migration chain or destructive downgrade; future schema changes need their own forward migration and recovery tests.

requirements.title: Automated CI
requirements.acceptance: CI runs necessary backend, frontend, type/build, contract and integration gates without live customer credentials.
requirements.verified_behavior: CI configuration installs locked dependencies, runs Ruff and pytest, exercises isolated PostgreSQL contention, builds/typechecks the frontend, builds a Docker image, and uploads evidence using synthetic credentials.
remaining_acceptance: Execute the configured workflow on the actual repository/build runner and retain its result. Browser workflow/contract acceptance is currently separate local evidence, not an invoked CI browser gate; the Docker build step has not run here.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Source and secret hygiene
requirements.acceptance: Source package excludes real PII/audio, generated databases, tokens and dependency directories.
requirements.verified_behavior: Git and Docker exclusions cover environment files, databases, caches, dependency directories, audio/model files and private key material. The only permitted checked-in WAV fixture location is explicitly synthetic research audio.
remaining_acceptance: Inspect the final distributable archive manifest and secret scan after packaging. Exclusion rules and source inspection alone do not prove that an arbitrary export/archive actually omits generated databases, tokens and dependency directories.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Provider capability registry
requirements.acceptance: Each integration advertises actual operations, model/endpoint/version, region, data terms and verification state.
requirements.verified_behavior: Integration status distinguishes active internal calendar, configured_unverified external services, demo-disabled sending and missing configuration. Call snapshots pin application/FSM/locale/calendar/adapter and configured speech versions, using not_recorded for unavailable values; privacy reporting lists processing regions as requiring review when unknown.
remaining_acceptance: Extend the integration registry to persist and expose each operation capability, actual endpoint/model revision, processing region, data terms and dated verification evidence. Environment booleans and call version tuples are not a complete approved per-integration registry.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Layered architecture
requirements.acceptance: Media remains separate from transactional booking; async workflow tooling cannot become calendar authority.
requirements.verified_behavior: AudioSocket/LiveKit process media separately and invoke the same authenticated application service. Calendar occupancy, read-back, idempotency, audit and logical outbox changes are governed by the transactional service; background messaging does not confirm appointments.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Legal operator and locations
requirements.acceptance: Tenant record distinguishes legal clinic operator, building membership and independent location ownership.
requirements.verified_behavior: Tenant building membership is distinct from the versioned clinic profile, which records legal operator, location label and ownership reference. Profile publication is owner/admin authorized and audited; public branding excludes legal ownership fields.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Validates the software distinction and authorization, not the truth of a submitted ownership declaration or a signed legal agreement.

requirements.title: Provider and service catalog
requirements.acceptance: Providers/services carry duration, buffers, price, prep, insurance notes, resource needs and active status.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner/admin catalog CRUD validates tenant-scoped providers/resources, arbitrary bounded duration, buffers, price, deposit, approval, activity and practitioner shifts. Inactive catalog entries can be restored without silently dropping resource needs.
remaining_acceptance: Preparation and insurance facts are clinic-level approved FAQ/description content, not explicit per-service, versioned preparation and insurance-policy fields. Demonstrate correct service-specific selection before treating the full catalog acceptance as complete.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Policy publication
requirements.acceptance: Approved configuration has version, author/reviewer, effective time and audit trail.
requirements.verified_behavior: Settings publication is owner/admin authorized, optimistic-version checked, tenant serialized, audited and appended to immutable policy revisions with actor and publication time. FAQ facts carry approver, source and effective/expiry times; production activation additionally requires a current reviewer-bound policy/catalog UAT attestation.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: General configuration takes effect on publication; fact validity may be scheduled. The authorized publisher may also be the reviewer; an independent two-person approval workflow is not claimed.

requirements.title: Routing configuration
requirements.acceptance: DID, clinic, provider, queue and allowlisted human destination mappings are versioned and validated.
requirements.verified_behavior: Private authenticated PBX registration maps an exact DID to an active tenant and rejects unauthorized/reused registration IDs. Human transfer uses configured destinations rather than caller-provided numbers; browser overflow cannot self-assert PBX routing authority.
remaining_acceptance: Persist versioned DID/provider/queue/human destination mappings with approval history and complete cross-field validation. The current DID mapping and PBX staff route are operator environment/dialplan configuration, not one versioned application routing registry.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Staff authentication
requirements.acceptance: Staff authenticate with a production-appropriate password/identity flow and expiring/revocable sessions.
requirements.verified_behavior: Staff credentials use Argon2id, non-enumerating password verification and durable login attempt limiting. Staff JWTs have audience/issuer/expiry/token version; every protected request revalidates active user, tenant and membership, so membership revocation invalidates current authority.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Password and scoped-session implementation; no SSO/MFA deployment or organizational account recovery process is asserted.

requirements.title: Roles and memberships
requirements.acceptance: Receptionist, manager, coordinator, billing and technical permissions are explicit and tenant scoped.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner, admin, receptionist, clinician and limited partner memberships are tenant scoped. Team grants require an owner, collisions are reconciled transactionally, and revoked membership immediately removes access.
remaining_acceptance: Define and test the distinct coordinator, billing and technical permissions requested by the blueprint. Current owner/admin permissions combine several of those responsibilities rather than representing the complete least-privilege role matrix.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Object scope enforcement
requirements.acceptance: Every read/write/worker/export rejects cross-tenant resource IDs even if an attacker knows the ID.
requirements.verified_behavior: Calendar/resource identifiers are scoped by server-derived tenant authority. Operations and partner exports enforce tenant predicates and current membership/credential scope; test suites exercise known cross-tenant IDs, signed slot misuse and inaccessible workflow objects.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Source inspection and named negative authorization regressions, not a claim of exhaustive penetration testing of every possible object path.

requirements.title: Minimal patient data
requirements.acceptance: Collect only required operational identity; encrypt sensitive contacts/notes and mask default views.
requirements.verified_behavior: Appointments collect operational identity rather than diagnosis, and encrypt patient name/phone. Phone lookups use independent HMAC; normal list views mask phone numbers. Sensitive staff notes, caller state, proof payloads and partner destinations use encrypted fields, with safe log formatting excluding arbitrary sensitive text.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Authorized appointment staff still see the patient name required for reception; access-controlled operational identity is not represented as anonymous data.

requirements.title: Safe credential custody
requirements.acceptance: Supplier and signing secrets remain server-side, are rotatable and excluded from frontend/source/logs.
requirements.verified_behavior: Provider secrets remain server-side environment/configuration inputs; tokens are scoped or hashed at rest as appropriate. Safe logging drops arbitrary text, environment templates use placeholders, and key rotation/revocation is documented with tested nested ciphertext rotation and stable lookup identities.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Application custody and rotation controls; production secret-vault provisioning and actual custodian access review are operator responsibilities. Final archive hygiene is assessed separately.

requirements.title: Audit of overrides
requirements.acceptance: Privileged access, policy changes, exports, staff interventions and identity corrections record actor and reason.
requirements.verified_behavior: Policy publications, partner/privacy exports, manual appointment corrections, task lifecycle actions, team changes and intervention events retain actor/entity/action evidence. Correction and policy reasons are encrypted where free text is stored.
remaining_acceptance: Specify and enforce a uniform reason/evidence policy for every privileged override/export/access class. Some current audit records contain an action and actor with a generated reason or no separately supplied reason; ordinary privileged reads are not comprehensively audited.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Request and transport protection
requirements.acceptance: Deployable origin/TLS/cookie/token/CSRF policy and request-size constraints are documented and enforced.
requirements.verified_behavior: Bearer tokens are used rather than ambient authentication cookies; CORS origins are explicit and credential cookies disabled. Production rejects insecure origins, emits HSTS and security headers, and the supplied Caddy edge enforces a body-size ceiling and hides internal media/metrics routes. Audio containers have independent bounds.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Deployable policy and application checks are locally inspected/tested. Public TLS certificates, proxy configuration and NAT/firewall behavior must be verified at the real deployment; the app Content-Length check alone is not a streaming request-size firewall.

requirements.title: Export and deletion authorization
requirements.acceptance: Export/correction/deletion requests require correct subject or clinic authority and scoped audit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Privacy export/deletion and contact/time corrections require active owner/admin authority, tenant-scoped lookup and audited effects. Erasure covers linked notes/proofs/turns while retaining minimal active appointment evidence and creating review instead of silently canceling business records.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Clinic-authority workflow is implemented. A separate unassisted public subject-access portal is not claimed.

requirements.title: Authoritative calendar selection
requirements.acceptance: Every tenant has one approved appointment authority and connector capability profile.
requirements.verified_behavior: All current tenants use the one internal transactional calendar, and its integration status says active. External adapters fail closed unless approved capabilities exist; the code does not silently install a second calendar authority.
remaining_acceptance: Add a persisted per-tenant approved authority/capability profile before supporting authority selection. External calendar adoption, canonical identifiers and authoritative write ownership are not wired into the live booking service.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Live scoped availability
requirements.acceptance: Only valid provider/service/resource slots are returned with canonical ID, freshness and display labels.
requirements.verified_behavior: Availability validates tenant-scoped active provider/service/resources, clinic and practitioner hours, closures, lead time and horizon. Offers carry canonical signed slot identifiers, expiry and policy version; commit rechecks current capacity and policy.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Provider duration exclusion
requirements.acceptance: Overlapping intervals including unequal service durations and buffers cannot be confirmed concurrently.
requirements.verified_behavior: Database-unique per-minute occupancy includes the full appointment duration and buffer. Unequal starts and service lengths conflict correctly, not merely identical timestamps; failed moves retain original claims.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Room and equipment exclusion
requirements.acceptance: Required room/chair/equipment/staff occupancy participates in the same reservation conflict rules.
requirements.verified_behavior: Provider and required shared resource occupancy are claimed in the same transaction and uniqueness namespace. Resource configuration is scoped to the tenant, and an actual 100-contender PostgreSQL shared-resource scenario produced one winner.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Hundred-way contention
requirements.acceptance: 100 independent contenders for one synthetic capacity-one slot yield at most one confirmed booking.
requirements.verified_behavior: The retained PostgreSQL report records 100 independent contenders for one capacity-one slot: one created appointment, 99 SLOT_TAKEN outcomes, and zero duplicate occupancy. Separate shared-resource/hold/idempotency scenarios and simultaneous rescheduling also passed.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Actual isolated PostgreSQL connection contention using synthetic records; this does not establish carrier/media capacity or production throughput.

requirements.title: Unknown external write
requirements.acceptance: Timeout after submit creates reconciliation state and does not blindly retry or speak confirmed.
requirements.verified_behavior: The external calendar prototype issues at most one write, looks up the idempotency key after unknown outcome, then verifies canonical read-back and requested slot/patient token. Missing atomicity capabilities reject the write.
remaining_acceptance: Persist external operation/reconciliation state and connect it to the tenant-selected live booking workflow. The current prototype can return UNKNOWN errors but does not provide a durable external booking reconciliation queue or complete integrated caller/staff recovery.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: External conflict recovery
requirements.acceptance: A concurrent staff/website write is detected or the action remains supervised pending review.
requirements.verified_behavior: Staff UI, public voice and supported partner voice notes all use the same internal calendar; database occupancy and optimistic revision checks reject concurrent conflicting writes or stale moves. Unsupported operations route to staff rather than inventing confirmation.
remaining_acceptance: Detect/reconcile writes made in an independently operated clinic website/EHR/calendar. No verified external synchronization source is connected, so the internal conflict test cannot establish external website conflict recovery.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: State transitions
requirements.acceptance: Held, pending payment/approval, confirmed, cancel/reschedule pending, canceled, expired and failed-review transitions are explicit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Internal hold, approval, payment, confirmation, cancellation and expiry states are explicit; transition checks, stale versions, financial review and atomic moves are tested. Pending approval/payment is not described as confirmed.
remaining_acceptance: Complete explicit durable cancel-pending, reschedule-pending and failed-review states for uncertain external calendar operations. Current internal transactional actions commit or reject atomically, and operational tasks do not implement the full external operation state graph.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Operation audit
requirements.acceptance: All booking transitions retain original IDs, revision, actor, authorization and source outcome.
requirements.verified_behavior: Internal booking mutations retain stable appointment/reference identifiers, optimistic revision, authenticated actor and audit events for create/cancel/reschedule/approval/outcome. Staff corrections retain before/after evidence without rewriting financial history.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Verified for the internal authoritative calendar. External provider operation revisions/outcomes require the missing reconciliation integration assessed under BOOKING-011/024.

requirements.title: Transaction outbox
requirements.acceptance: Booking and its logical notification are atomically durable while delivered status remains separate.
requirements.verified_behavior: Appointment/occupancy mutation, logical notification and audit are committed atomically; idempotent replay cannot create a second booking/message. Provider acceptance, delivery, failure and unknown outcome remain distinct outbox states.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Service rule exceptions
requirements.acceptance: First/follow-up visits, packages and 10/20/40-minute examples honor tenant policy rather than global tiers.
requirements.verified_behavior: Services accept independent durations, buffers, prices, resources and approval/deposit policies. Calendar arithmetic uses the selected service rather than fixed global 10/20/40-minute tiers, and manual service correction rechecks the new duration/resources.
remaining_acceptance: Model and test explicit first-visit/follow-up eligibility and multi-service/package exceptions. Naming an ordinary service as a follow-up or package does not establish package entitlement or visit-history policy enforcement.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Calendar sync reconciliation
requirements.acceptance: Webhook or polling revisions track lag, stale data and conflicts without creating a shadow source of truth.
requirements.verified_behavior: The internal calendar has optimistic versions and the external prototype verifies a single create/read-back result. No second shadow calendar is automatically populated.
remaining_acceptance: Implement per-integration webhook/poll revision ingestion, synchronization cursor/lag, conflict recording and recovery. The current adapter has no persistent calendar sync/reconciliation ledger, so this full acceptance is not implemented.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Usage event ledger
requirements.acceptance: Unique source/call/tenant events record meter, quantity, unit, rate version, currency and adjustments.
requirements.verified_behavior: Durable usage events contain tenant, optional call, kind, quantity, unit, cost_toman and timestamp. End-of-call handling avoids duplicate call-duration charges; billing duration excludes STT processing seconds. Invoice snapshots and separate adjustments preserve history.
remaining_acceptance: Add source/provider receipt identifiers with semantic uniqueness, per-event rate version and currency, and a defined precision-safe cost basis. Random event primary keys and floating cost_toman do not satisfy the complete provider billing ledger contract.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Correct call denominators
requirements.acceptance: Attempted, connected, answered, eligible, resolved, confirmed and kept are defined distinctly.
requirements.verified_behavior: Daily/reporting aggregates distinguish call sessions, appointment statuses, confirmed booking counts, attendance and unknown attendance. STT seconds do not inflate call duration, and unknown outcomes are not coerced into attended/resolved counts.
remaining_acceptance: Instrument and document the complete attempted/connected/answered/eligible/resolved funnel, including attempted calls that never create an application session and partner/carrier eligibility denominators. Current session counts are not all those distinct metrics.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Invoice reconciliation
requirements.acceptance: Vendor receipts reconcile to tenant/provider usage with explicit discrepancy and dispute workflow.
requirements.verified_behavior: Closed-period invoice drafts snapshot authorized pricing, call-duration usage, adjustments and recorded costs without charging a customer. Patient deposit refund/dispute workflows exist as a separate financial domain.
remaining_acceptance: Implement vendor/carrier receipt import, provider-event matching, discrepancy tracking and vendor-cost dispute resolution. Patient payment disputes are not supplier invoice reconciliation, and no live supplier receipts are supplied.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Pooled building allowance
requirements.acceptance: Included minutes and overages allocate by contract and authorized clinic usage.
requirements.verified_behavior: Building pools require active owner authority over every included tenant in the same building and an explicit contract period/allowance/rate. Usage-based allocation uses integer Toman largest-remainder arithmetic to preserve exact pooled totals, excluding STT seconds.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Verified allocation software and entered contract configuration. Signed commercial terms, taxes and actual invoiced/collected money are not inferred.

requirements.title: Cost budget enforcement
requirements.acceptance: Soft alerts/hard caps and humane fallback include retries, silence and provider-specific charge units.
requirements.verified_behavior: Tenant admission accounts for persisted and active call duration, including logical-call silence; concurrency and maximum duration are bounded and 80-percent minute-budget warnings are exposed. Retries are bounded by operation type and uncertain non-idempotent sends are not blindly replayed.
remaining_acceptance: Enforce real currency-based soft/hard spending limits using actual provider/carrier billing units, rates, retries and rounded charge increments. Current minute/concurrency limits are not an all-provider cost budget and do not prove toll-fraud exposure limits.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Adjustment history
requirements.acceptance: Billing corrections preserve original events and identify approving actor/reason.
requirements.verified_behavior: Billing adjustments are append-only separate records, tenant/idempotency scoped and linked to an actor audit event and reason. Closed invoice snapshots retain their original usage/pricing/adjustments, and incompatible replay does not silently rewrite an issued snapshot.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Software draft invoice/adjustment history; not external accounting-system posting or payment collection.

requirements.title: Permissioned reporting exports
requirements.acceptance: Reports mask unnecessary patient data, carry definitions and enforce tenant/billing scopes.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner/admin billing APIs are tenant scoped, building reports require membership authority, and versioned partner exports remove patient names, phones and clinical notes. Reports label period/all-time scope, unknown attendance, allocation rules and draft invoice semantics.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Current billing privileges are owner/admin permissions; a distinct billing-only role remains a gap under AUTH-002. JSON reporting/export is implemented; formal statutory invoice compliance is not claimed.

requirements.title: Recording off by default
requirements.acceptance: No raw audio retained absent eligible configuration and actual permission; refusal keeps a supported service path.
requirements.verified_behavior: Raw audio recording and training are disabled by default and unsupported true consent requests are rejected. Caller intake requires processing permission, exposes a clinic phone/human route and supports staff handoff; neither browser nor PBX path silently stores raw recordings.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Recording-off implementation and offered human alternative are verified. Actual staffed availability on an owned telephone route is an external launch gate.

requirements.title: Ephemeral media handling
requirements.acceptance: Default media buffers are bounded and discarded; traces do not silently retain full patient audio/transcript.
requirements.verified_behavior: Default PCM/container handling is bounded in memory and raw audio is not written to a recording store. The public clinic notice explicitly discloses encrypted necessary conversation text/results for reception and recovery, the clinic retention period after call end, scheduled cleanup, a deletion request route and the separate treatment of necessary booking records. No transcript text is placed in logs; durable encrypted receipts preserve atomic replay.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: The focused test verifies a tenant-specific 14-day disclosure without leaking it to a second clinic configured for 30 days. Necessary recognized text remains encrypted for replay: this is disclosed retention, not ephemeral transcript processing. The operator must run the retention worker and honor deletion review; no exact deletion instant, deployed legal adequacy, or independent per-purpose retention controls are claimed.

requirements.title: Storage and access protection
requirements.acceptance: Sensitive objects have encryption/access control, expiry and no public playback URLs.
requirements.verified_behavior: Sensitive patient/contact, call context, turn receipt, verification secret, staff note and partner destination values are encrypted. Authentication and tenant checks guard access; scoped caller/media capabilities expire; raw recordings/public playback objects do not exist in the implemented default flow.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Existing application objects only. Any future recording/object storage needs its own private-object access, expiry and processor approval; encrypted data still requires correct deployment key custody.

requirements.title: Calendar adapter contract
requirements.acceptance: List/get/hold/create/cancel/update/read-back/reconcile capability tests are reusable per integration.
requirements.verified_behavior: The approved-calendar prototype exposes a capabilities check and conditional/idempotent create with read-back and unknown-write lookup. Tests reject unsupported capabilities and assert no second POST after an unknown write.
remaining_acceptance: Complete the reusable list/get/hold/create/cancel/update/read-back/reconcile contract and capability test matrix. Current external adapter coverage is create/reconcile/read-back only and is not selected by tenant calendar authority.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Partner scopes and dashboard
requirements.acceptance: Partner/agency access is explicit per tenant and cannot bypass clinic authority.
requirements.verified_behavior: One-time-issued partner keys are hashed at rest, scope limited, tenant bound, expiring and revocable. Each use revalidates active issuing owner authority, user and tenant; limited partner membership cannot access normal staff/patient operations.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Provider/API exports
requirements.acceptance: Permissioned API/export contracts are versioned and support deprecation and audit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Partner export routes use /partner/v1, a version response header, bounded date/row limits, explicit key scopes and audit records. Appointment exports omit patient identity and have a schema_version plus deprecation field.
remaining_acceptance: Define and test a deprecation/sunset lifecycle and compatibility behavior for changing an export version. A permanently null deprecation field and a single v1 implementation do not yet demonstrate supported deprecation.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Owner digest channel abstraction
requirements.acceptance: Telegram/Bale/Eitaa or email-style digests can be configured only with platform permission and recipient scope.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner-only digest destinations bind tenant, encrypted recipient and consent reference. Manual or explicitly opted-in daily scheduling is deduplicated; dispatch rechecks owner/tenant/destination authority and requires an approved allowlisted gateway. Unknown sends are not automatically resent and acceptance is only SENT.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Verified common gateway abstraction and scope/approval controls for Telegram/Bale/Eitaa/email-style channels. Native platform accounts, native adapters and actual recipient delivery remain PARTNER-GATE-003, not claimed by this local status.

requirements.title: Messaging suppression across channels
requirements.acceptance: WhatsApp/Telegram/SMS/social permissions and opt-outs remain purpose/channel specific.
requirements.verified_behavior: Channel grants require tenant, subject hash, channel and purpose. Eligibility requires explicit active permission and no suppression; withdrawal cannot be overridden by an unrelated grant. Digest destination disablement suppresses queued work, and unsupported social transports do not send.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Permission and suppression logic for configured channel abstractions; native social-platform access and end-to-end delivery have not been provisioned.

requirements.title: Booking partner write access
requirements.acceptance: A selected Paziresh24/Doctoreto/EHR/calendar provider grants clinic-specific create/update/cancel/read rights.
requirements.verified_behavior: The code explicitly treats external calendar access as unproven and does not advertise a vendor write integration as active.
remaining_acceptance: Supply a selected provider contract, clinic-specific scoped write/read rights, sandbox credentials and actual create/update/cancel/read-back UAT.
external_dependencies: Provider contract, sandbox, scoped credentials, real integration UAT
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.verified_behavior: Only the internal calendar is fully integrated; named additional calendars are not asserted as supported production authorities.
remaining_acceptance: Individually implement and verify each selected official calendar integration with clinic authorization and its supported capability matrix.

requirements.title: Prescription/insurance portals
requirements.acceptance: Any dedicated insurance/e-prescription integration requires separate authorization and is never achieved by scraping.
requirements.verified_behavior: No scraping-based insurance/e-prescription connector or assumed portal access is implemented.
remaining_acceptance: Obtain dedicated commercial/legal permission and implement/test only the specifically authorized portal API if the product gate is activated.

requirements.title: Agency distribution terms
requirements.acceptance: White-label/revenue share/partner support terms are signed rather than inferred from example 70/30 split.
requirements.verified_behavior: Software partner scopes and entered building terms do not assert an agreed revenue split or agency support commitment.
remaining_acceptance: Record signed white-label/revenue-share/support agreements and real operating responsibilities; the example 70/30 split is not evidence.
external_dependencies: Partner agreement and operational support capability
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Redacted tracing
requirements.acceptance: Call/turn/tool/job/booking correlation IDs link outcomes with versioned configuration and no raw sensitive logs.
requirements.verified_behavior: Structured logging allowlists static events, correlation IDs, error class and driver code, excluding SQL/parameters and arbitrary message text. Calls/turns/bookings/jobs have durable identifiers and call policy/version snapshots; HTTP metrics use route templates and latency reports label their actual observation boundaries.
remaining_acceptance: Complete a documented end-to-end correlation chain across every call/turn/tool/provider/job/booking outcome and test reconstruction after a process restart. Current IDs and redaction controls do not provide a universal distributed trace contract.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Actionable alerts
requirements.acceptance: False confirmation, cross-tenant access, toll/spend spikes, queue delay and delivery backlog have escalation thresholds.
requirements.verified_behavior: Scoped health and supplied Prometheus rules define queue-age, unknown-delivery, stale-task, recorded safety incident, API failure and availability thresholds. Minute-budget exposure warns at 80 percent; incidents instruct operators to pause and use the runbook.
remaining_acceptance: Add actual provider/toll/currency-spike detection and test notification/escalation to the assigned on-call destination. Empty safety logs are not zero unobserved incidents, and supplied alert rules do not constitute an operating pager.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Backup automation
requirements.acceptance: Encrypted database/config backup runs with retention and checksums under documented ownership.
requirements.verified_behavior: Backup tooling streams pg_dump directly into GPG, publishes atomically without overwrite, writes private checksum manifests, and has validated retention/legal-hold rules. Hardened systemd service/timer templates and operating ownership instructions exist.
remaining_acceptance: Execute and observe the scheduled job under the real owner and offsite retention destination. The implemented automation backs up the database; independently encrypted configuration/key-inventory backup and its recovery procedure need operational implementation and evidence.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.

requirements.title: Restore drill tooling
requirements.acceptance: Documented recovery procedure restores a test backup and verifies appointment and outbox consistency.
requirements.verified_behavior: An actual isolated PostgreSQL backup/restore streamed an encrypted archive without a plaintext dump, restored into an empty target, matched all 51 table counts, found zero duplicate/orphan occupancy and verified application-field decryption. Restore rejects unsafe target/checksum conditions and documents rollback isolation.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Synthetic quiescent restore-tool drill, not proof of offsite durability, production RPO/RTO, live-write snapshot count equivalence or a real custodian exercise.

requirements.title: Secrets and key recovery
requirements.acceptance: Rotation/revocation and backup encryption key recovery are documented and testable.
requirements.verified_behavior: The runbook defines JWT/partner/session revocation, independent stable lookup key custody and offline Fernet rotation. Rotation covers mapped and nested encrypted values, survives mixed-key restarts and is idempotent; the encrypted PostgreSQL restore exercised decryption with the available recovery keys.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Verified software and test-key recovery procedure. Real escrow, independent custodians, key-loss response and retired-backup retention remain operator deployment evidence.

requirements.title: Capacity and staff simulator
requirements.acceptance: Queue staffing uses arrival/handoff/handling distributions, utilization, shrinkage and peak buffers.
requirements.verified_behavior: The bounded reproducible simulator models Poisson arrivals, lognormal handling, handoff rate, staff shrinkage, peak multipliers, patience/abandonment and queue utilization. It labels assumptions, preserves denominators and treats released time as reassigned capacity unless avoidable-cost evidence exists.
requirements.scope: Independent platform, security, calendar, partner, billing and deployment assessment. This proposal does not edit the main requirement register.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Verified synthetic planning tool, not observed clinic arrival distributions, measured staffing savings or a guarantee of real service levels.
